items.summary: “I have discovered a new way to learn – by shutting my mouth and listening ... It’s not so much what I’m doing as what I’m not doing. I’m not talking. So I’m open; I’m teachable.” Houston, Texas, June 1976, From: “Growth”, Emotional Sobriety: The Next Frontier Daily Quote at www.aagrapevine.org

items.summary: “Alcohol en latín se dice spiritus y se usa la misma palabra para denominar la más sublime experiencia religiosa y el veneno más depravador. Por lo tanto, la fórmula útil será: spiritus contra spiritum”. "“La correspondencia de Bill W. con Carl Jung” DR. C. G. JUNG, ENERO DE 1963 De El lenguaje del corazón" Cita Diaria en www.aalavina.org

I’ve also served my time as a maker of rules, a regulator of other people’s conduct ... I can now look back upon such experiences with much amusement. And gratitude as well.” AA Co-Founder, Bill W., September 1945, From: “’Rules’ Dangerous but Unity Vital”…
